title: One More Tweak
summary: Fixed DNS for www subdomain.... hopefully
content: Had to make one more adjustment to the Firebase configuration, it treats www.davidcouncil.com and davidcouncil.com as unique domains and needed configuration as such. We will see if this fixes it.

title: First Post On davidcouncil.com
content:
Took me a couple of days of trying things, waiting for DNS propagation, discovering my settings were wrong, etc. but I finally got davidcouncil.com linked to this new app hosted on Firebase/GCP!

Next steps will be:
Ironing out wrinkles in the content editor
Creating a more dynamic way to link SoundCloud content
Finding my RCA cords lost at RaveYard and get back to mixing
